info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Human Resource Management Workforce Training-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Workforce Training Management API facilitates the creation and management of training programs for employees within the banking sector. This API allows organizations to design, register, and oversee workforce training initiatives efficiently, enhancing employee skills and productivity. Typical consumers include HR professionals and training coordinators who require a streamlined process for implementing training solutions. Through this endpoint, users can initiate new workforce training modules aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.

post.summary: Create a new workforce training program
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a new workforce training program within the human resource management system. You can define the details of the training, including the objectives, duration, and target employees.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit data related to workforce training operations within the human resource management system. It should contain all relevant information required to process the training event, including participant details, training topics, and scheduling information.

201.description: Resource created successfully, and the training has been scheduled.
